When you go to all in him, ult the SECOND he is in execute range. Sometimes Tryndamere players don't expect the ult to kill and they hold it. If he pops ult, sprint back to tower and wait it out. Ping for a gank after to finish him off. Team fight into Tryndamere, you don't win in a side lane unless ahead.

Your main focus is to take his turret every time he ults, since you can't follow his teleport. Rush Hullbreaker and ping when he ults.You generally should be ahead of gold to him as long as your team listens to pings and doesn't int him TOO hard (I know they often will int anyway). Play to splitpush, if he ults elsewhere on the map you can take multiple towers for it. It's similar to playing into Shen top. Save your W for his gold card, then run him down with Phase Rush.

blocos.texto: Avoid getting hit by his flip level 1, it can chunk you out of lane easily. Once you're level 3, you can trade with him. Save W to block his flip, if he misses use W to block his passive. Use the Ghosting on your E to spin around him and avoid the passive on his shotgun legs, and ESPECIALLY once he's 6 to dodge his ult. It's nearly impossible for him to hit his ult as long as you spin in circles. Split push if ahead, team fight if behind.

blocos.texto: Incredibly rare mid matchup, but your hardest ADC matchup including Tristana / Lucian / Vayne. HIGHLY recommend dodging, you're not fighting a Varus mid next lobby. You need to try and keep the wave shoved as much as possible, because Varus can poke and kill you under turret without him ever being in danger. Spam ping for ganks - it's the only way you're killing him before you have 2 items. Run Cleanse if you NEED to survive lane (for his ult) or run Ghost and play for jungle ganks otherwise.

blocos.texto: HIGHLY RECOMMENDED DODGE! Like Varus, Vayne mid is extremely uncommon and you're not going to get it next lobby. If you're set on playing the game out, play safe and avoid trying to kill her. Focus on wave clearing- rush Tiamat and just clear waves. Look to roam top or bot and try to get a lead that way, you can't 1v1 Vayne unless she makes a massive mistake early. Be careful if she follows your roams, she will out 2v2 you. PLAY FOR TEAM FIGHTS!

Lane Viego got nerfed pretty bad, but I still see it mid occassionally. He can poke you decently well level 1, so only walk up to last hit. Save W for his stun. You can start trading with auto Q E at level 3, when you have Phase Rush available. Matchup gets easier once you have Tiamat, and a pretty much guaranteed kill once you have Stridebreaker. I've noticed that most Viego mids tend to roam because they have a hard time killing Garen, so ping when he does. You can follow and force fights, or take his turret quickly. Up to you. Splitpush, he cannot match you at all if you're even or ahead late game.

tldr: Split push or team fight, depending on the game

blocos.texto: Stand behind at least 2 minions so he doesn't gain Q stacks off of hitting you. Save W for his cage to walk out of it, or to block his ult's damage. Be very careful for jungle ganks, Veigar's cage is free setup for them. Expect to get camped. Split pushing and team fighting are both valid options, but are both difficult due to his cage. Matchup gets even harder if he builds Zhonya's as well. Roaming early is viable. The best time to try and kill him is when he's trying to shove a wave in a side lane away from tower, so try to hide in bushes and go for that.

blocos.texto: This matchup is similar to Xerath, the difficulty is based entirely on how well you can dodge his skill shots. Rush Swifties first item, movement speed is his biggest counter. If he lands knockup, run away until his passive resets. If not, he will ult you once his passive is stacked and delete you with true damage. If you dodge his knockup, run at him with Q and punish him for it. That is essentially his only peel. Splitpush, Vel can't match you one you have Force of Nature and Hullbreaker.

blocos.texto: She pokes hard early. Stand to the side of the minions so she has to use spells to wave clear, this will significantly lower her potential poke. Use W when her fear is up, this will help you stick on her. Save Flash to dodge her ult and finish her off. Split push into this matchup, once you have Force of Nature and Hullbreaker she can't match you in a side lane. Matchup difficulty is mainly due to her early poke, things get MUCH easier later on.

blocos.texto: His level 1 and 2 poke will be insanely strong, try to stay back as much as possible. Last hit minions, don't worry about trading with him until you have 2 points in Q. Trading gets easier with Tiamat, and even easier with Stridebreaker. Save W for his cage if possible, it's very useful for setting up ganks. Matchup difficulty depends on how fed he gets early, and on how good he is at poking you out of lane. Split push if even or ahead, team fight if behind. GAREN OUTSCALES VIKTOR, YOU WIN FULL BUILD VS FULL BUILD.

Trading will be difficult, attempt to trade when his pool is on CD. He has a LOT of built in sustain, so don't worry too much about anti heal until after you have Stridebreaker. Try to save Ghost for when he uses Ghost, and use Ignite to all in and deny a heal. Roaming for kills early is also viable, once you have Tiamat you out wave clear him pretty hard. Split push in this matchup, Vlad wants to team fight.

blocos.texto: THIS MATCHUP IS LOSE LANE WIN GAME. You need to play INCREDIBLY safe. ONLY trade once you have Tiamat and Phase Rush up. If he zones you off farm level 1, just stay in exp range. He hard outrades you early game. His healing increases based on the lower his HP is, so kills aren't guaranteed early unless you have Ignite up and he has ult down. If your jungler tries to gank before lvl 6, spam ping them off. You will probably lose 1v2 and DEFINITELY lose 2v2. Rush Executioner's Calling second after Tiamat. Splitpush, after 2 items you outscale.

tldr: Split push or team fight, depending on the game

blocos.texto: If he tries to all in you level 1, auto Q and walk back towards tower while autoing. You will go even with him. Play safe level 2, then start trading with him level 3. When he E-Q's into you, IMMEDIEATELY W & Q. If he got his clone off, E through his clone and follow him backwards. If he didn't get the clone off, stick on him until your silence wears off. AVOID long trades, he gains health regen and armor the longer you trade. Ignite helps keep track of which Wukong is real. Careful about level 6, if he's not below 50% HP he beats you in an all in. Splitpush or team fight.

blocos.texto: Stand to the side of your minions, not behind them. Xerath will have to use spells to farm the wave, instead of poking you. Farm up and rush Swifties to help dodge his skill shots. Save your W to block his root, It's Xerath's only CC. This matchup is an automatic win for the rest of the game once you have Stridebreaker, Xerath doesn't have the peel in his kit to kite you. Split push as well, Xerath cannot stop you.

Easy matchup, I've fought this where he goes both AD AND AP builds. Play safe levels 1-2, that's where he is the strongest . W his engage level 3, take a short trade with Q-E, then run back to turret. Wear him down slowly until level 6, then try to burst him before he gets his ult off. Keep in mind he can block your ult damage with his ult if he knocks you back in time, so you have to be quick. Get antiheal after Stridebreaker, it will help with split pushing.

blocos.texto: Use Tiamat on minions to break his passive from range- it helps with trades IMMENSELY. Max Q if you want to play safer. Max E for higher kill pressure early. Don't fight level 1, if he tries to all in, auto Q and kite back to tower while autoing him. Your goal is to just wait until 6, where you can nearly all in him. If he has passive and boneplating down, you can kill him from about 75% HP with QER Ignite. Split Push if even or ahead, team fight if behind. In teamfights, your goal is to just silence ult him every time he dashes in.

tldr: Split push or team fight, depending on the game

blocos.texto: Probably one of Garen's most even skill matchups mid, if the Yone knows what he is doing. Don't trade level 1, just farm. If he tries to all in you level 1, auto Q and walk back towards tower, autoing him every time you can while kiting back. You can start taking trades level 3 when W is up. Wait for him to miss his Q3, then run in and do a trade with QWE. Kill pressure rises sharply at 6, if he's at around 50% HP you can all in with QER Ignite. Split push if ahead, teamfight if even or behind. Your job is to burst him when he goes in in team fights.

tldr: Split push or team fight, depending on the game

Make sure to grab some armor early if he's going lethality as well, it'll help a LOT. Split if ahead, otherwise shove side waves then rotate to team fights.

blocos.texto: Complete skill matchup, MAYBE slightly Zed favored for kills, but Garen counters Zed in team fights. Don't stand near his shadows in lane. Get boots early to help dodge his Qs. W if you're going to get hit by a combo, otherwise save W for his ult. When he ults you, IMMEDIATELY Silence and Phase Rush back to your turret. It should be a guaranteed kill if he follows you to turret. You generally want to team fight when Zed is on the enemy team, as you can silence him as soon as he goes for your squishies. Q-E-R him after hes in and save your team! Split pushing IS possible, but I don't recommend it early game, esp if Zed is fed.

blocos.texto: He pokes INSANELY hard early, but the second you have Swifties and Tiamat you win for the rest of the game. Once you're level 6, Q at him to get him to use his knockback. Once it's on cooldown, Ghost and Q at him again. you can literally one combo him after that with Tiamat E R. Split push in this matchup, but don't bother split pushing until you have Hullbreaker, as Ziggs will oneshot waves until you have it.You can grab refill potion as well to help with his poke early, but as long as you keep moving you should be able to dodge his skillshots.

blocos.texto: Difficulty depends on how well Zilean can land bombs, but generally lane is pretty easy, AND you hard outscale him. Save your Q to cleanse his slow, Save your W for his stun. To optimally trade with him, walk towards him without Q'ing. When he slows, Q to cleanse then E on him until your spin is done. Finish off the trade with Q, and walk away. (or ult him if hes in execute range.) This guarantees that you can kill him without him being able to ult himself. IF he double slows use, Q on him then Tiamat+E to get Phase Rush, it gives you 75% slow resistance. run him down after that. Split push, Zilean wants to team fight.

blocos.texto: Play safe early, lane will be hell but you will outscale her. Get Swifties first to dodge her skill shots. Play around minions, they block her skill shots as well. Keep in mind she can steal your summs after you use them as well, so play around that fact. Use W right before Drowsy completes- You will deny a huge part of her burst. Zoe doesn't have good wave clear, Try to shove her into turret and outroam her. You outscale eventually, but will need around 3 items to consistently kill her assuming she doesn't make positioning mistakes. Split push if she's behind or even, team fight if she's ahead.

She is going to poke you pretty hard early, bring double MR in your runes. Try to save W for her root. Step on her plants before she grows them fully to avoid some poke damage. Try to save Flash to dodge her ult OR to burst her down before she CAN ult. Once laning phase is over, you've basically outscaled her. Splitpush, she can't match you once you're at 2-3 items. Zyra can setup ganks somewhat easily, so let her shove wave towards your tower so you can play safer.
